basic_info.description: Welcome to 1678-25th Avenue, a well-located classic San Francisco home in prime Central Sunset location. Main level features spacious living room with fireplace, large formal dining room, bright kitchen with breakfast area and private patio, two spacious bedrooms, sunroom, and 1 1/2 bathrooms. Lower level features separate entrance, 2+ car parking, laundry area, storage, and more. House offers abundant 1920's details throughout. Other features include fresh paint, rich refinished hardwood floors, and expansive rear yard. Sparkling clean and move-in ready. This exceptional home sits atop a generous 2,226 sq ft lot. Prime location just minutes from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Stonestown Galleria, Irving and Noriega shops and dining options. Minutes to downtown S.F. and easy access to the peninsula. This home offers a wonderful lifestyle in ideal location w additional expansion potential in the coveted Central Sunset.
